compiled_kernel_resources.scope: Static compiler declarations, not measured occupancy.

implementation: A48-byte K16 row retains32 bytes of original BF16 values, three dwords of5-bit exponent-deficit fields and the original row maximum. Deficits are clamped to15, with zero assigned15. Ordinary dword addition yields16 exact pair deficits because each sum is at most30 and cannot carry into another field. A minimum below15 excludes every clipped or zero operand from the maximizing pair and yields the exact product maximum. Zero rows retain the original floor; unsupported rows and uncertain minima decline. The fast scalar kernel loads packed BF16 pairs into LDS plus separate metadata planes, computes each original exact FP32 product, and retains the unchanged ordered K16 modulo alignment and FP32 endpoint normalization. Any decline uses the existing complete original dot replay kernel.32/64/128-element windows are compared with retained and deferred-scan controls. No product dispatcher changes.
correctness_scope: Sanitized host tests cover all65536 BF16 encodings and1048576 group pairs with narrow/wide exponents, zeros, invalid values and deliberately saturated deficits. All592595 accepted maxima equal direct original product maxima;455981 declined calls leave output unchanged. Native110 shape/variant cases cover full scores, independent CPU dots, masks, tails, late unsupported values, overflowing endpoints, saturated metadata and tiny product scales. Every captured score buffer, including unused tails and guards, is compared to the original computation after every warmup and rotated timing. CPU independently reconstructs all prepared rows and flags, and verifies original inputs and transpose. q8192 repeats the first1023 captured rows and is an operator extension, not a new GB10 continuation or external attention-context result.
timing_scope: Completed per-slab steady-host clocks include the candidate kernel and complete original fallback scan. Each arm adds its own measured full Q/K preparation and key transpose: the old32-bit decoded representation for controls and the new48-byte K16 representation for candidates. Both representations coexist only for this comparison; construction, allocation, resets and validation are outside slab timers. All five arms use the same128-query slabs and16x16 score tiles with rotated ordering. Static resource declarations do not prove occupancy or product savings. No load, TTFT, token, retained-performance or release acceptance follows.

decision.decision: Keep the isolated exact metadata representation and numerical fixture; do not integrate this QK schedule. Best candidate q7169/q8192 including preparation is276.1086/359.9548ms, versus270.9788/355.8266ms retained controls and251.7516/331.3189ms deferred controls. Candidates do not beat the retained query kernel even before their measured preparation costs. Lower compiled VGPR/LDS declarations and fewer operand bytes do not establish faster execution. Prefer a broader reduction in completed work while product TTFT exceeds10seconds.
